info.title: Euron TokenProfiler
info.description:
LLM observability: traces, token and cost attribution, prompts, budgets and alerts.

**Ingest plane** (`/v1`): send `Authorization: Bearer tp_...` with a project API key.
`POST /v1/ingest` takes the native batch the Python SDK sends; `POST /v1/otlp/v1/traces`
takes OpenTelemetry OTLP/HTTP (JSON or protobuf, gzip accepted). `GET /v1/prompts/{name}`
fetches a managed prompt.

**Control plane** (`/api/v1`): projects, traces, metrics, prompts, prices, budgets, alerts
and people, for signed-in users (session cookie or `Bearer <session token>`).

Every error uses one envelope: `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details?"}}`.

post.summary: Send traces and spans (native batch, used by the Python SDK)
post.description: Items are validated one by one: invalid ones are listed under `rejected` and the rest are stored. Spans and traces may arrive in any order and in any number of requests; a span sent again replaces the earlier copy.

post.summary: OpenTelemetry OTLP/HTTP traces (JSON or protobuf, gzip accepted)
post.description: Set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` to `<api>/v1/otlp` and the header `Authorization=Bearer tp_...`. Spans follow the OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions (`gen_ai.*`); OpenInference and `tokenprofiler.*` attributes are understood too. The response is an OTLP `ExportTraceServiceResponse`.
